'''Aylayl''' was a verdant [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Aylayl system/Legends|Aylayl system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> and lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]], which connected it to the worlds of [[Hollastin]] and [[Tsyk]].<ref name="TEA" />

The surface of Aylayl was covered in deep [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and spiky [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], and the planet<ref name="TEA" /> was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] for metal [[Ore/Legends|ore]] and [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] by beings [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aylayl was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square S-12.<ref name="TEA" />
